RAJYA SABHA 
Thursday, the 4th December, 2003/13 Agrahayana, 1925 (Saka) 
The House met at eleven of the clock, 
MR. CHAIRMAN in the Chair. 
RE. ADJOURNMENT OF THE HOUSE 
MR. CHAIRMAN: Questions....{Interruptions).... 
SHRI PRANAB MUKHERJEE (West Bengal): Sir, before you take 
up the Question Hour, I have a small submission to make as many of 
the Members from this side have suggested that they are interested in 
watching the proceedings of the election results. And if, from the 
Government side, the hon. Leader of the House agrees, we may adjourn 
the House today. However, from this side, I can assure the Government 
that, sitting extra hours from next Monday, we will transact all the 
Government Business. 
THE LEADER OF THE HOUSE (S HRI JASWANT SINGH): Sir, I 
absolutely and entirely agree with  what hon. Pranab Babu has said, 
and it is understandable that the hon. Members from that side will 
really be interested because their hearts and minds are currently fixed 
on the result coming. So, I am entirely in agreement with whatever you 
decide, Sir, from the Chair. The proposal made by Pranab Babu is 
acceptable to us.
